picks.file: Общий вид ИВ в Альбоме видов русских городов.png
picks.what: General view, engraving in the Album of Views of Russian Towns (Moscow)
picks.why: skyline of churches and factory chimneys of Ivanovo-Voznesensk; caption trimmed

gaps: P0–P3: nothing of the city (manuscript and portraits held in the region); P5: posters only; P6: all modern photos are of Plyos, a different town
notes: #11 (1910 postcard, general view from a height) is also good but only 24 years after #9, so only one P4 view was taken; the engraving is sharper and shows the landmarks.
